name: Resend
description: Email API for developers. Send transactional and marketing emails at scale.

api_key.description: Alternatively, send a Resend API key as a Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer re_...`. Get one at https://resend.com/api-keys

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Your Resend API key. Get one at https://resend.com/api-keys

tools.name: emails
tools.description: Send, list, get, cancel, update, and batch send emails with HTML, attachments, CC/BCC, reply-to, scheduling, and tags

tools.name: received-emails
tools.description: List and read inbound emails and manage attachments

tools.name: contacts
tools.description: Create, list, get, update, and remove contacts with custom properties, segments, and topics

tools.name: broadcasts
tools.description: Create, send, list, get, update, and remove marketing campaigns with scheduling and personalization

tools.name: domains
tools.description: Create, list, get, update, remove, and verify sender domains with tracking, TLS, and DNS configuration

tools.name: segments
tools.description: Create, list, get, and remove audience segments

tools.name: topics
tools.description: Create, list, get, update, and remove subscription topics

tools.name: contact-properties
tools.description: Create, list, get, update, and remove custom contact attributes

tools.name: api-keys
tools.description: Create, list, and remove API keys

tools.name: templates
tools.description: Create, list, get, update, remove, publish, and duplicate email templates

tools.name: logs
tools.description: List and inspect API request logs for debugging, auditing, and reviewing recent API activity

tools.name: webhooks
tools.description: Create, list, get, update, and remove webhooks for event notifications

claude-web.setup: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → https://mcp.resend.com/mcp

claude-desktop.setup: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → https://mcp.resend.com/mcp

openclaw.command: openclaw mcp add resend --url https://mcp.resend.com/mcp --transport streamable-http
